tag: claims: Why did approval rate drop on 26 September compared with 19 September?

claims: Protea bank drove the drop on 26 sep 2026
The approval rate fell from 90.6% on 19 sep 2026 to 88.4% on 26 sep 2026, marking a change of -2.2 pp.
Protea bank contributed -2.5 pp as its approval rate dropped from 90.9% to 75.2%, making it the largest driver.
